acceptance_criterion: An event can have requests, holds, and confirmed bookings for several different venues at the same time, each recorded against the same event
test_name: records requests for several venues for the same period against the same event (L4-T1)

acceptance_criterion: Each venue is checked independently: suitability (K1), availability and conflicts (N1, N2), and approval or rejection by its own Venue Staff (M1, M2)
test_name: checks conflicts and approval at each venue on its own (L4-T3, N1, N2)

acceptance_criterion: The event shows all of its venue arrangements together, each with its venue, period, status, and booking reference
test_name: shows the event's booking, hold and request at three venues together (L4-T5)

acceptance_criterion: Withdrawing, rejecting, releasing, or changing one venue arrangement leaves the event's other arrangements unchanged
test_name: rejects one request and leaves the booking unflagged

acceptance_criterion: Cancelling the event (F3, F4) releases all of its venue arrangements
test_name: releases each booking and hold and withdraws each pending request, at every venue, and frees the venues

acceptance_criterion: Confirmation (F5) and registration capacity (R2, R7) take every venue into account, as answered by CQ-05 and CQ-04
test_name: F5-T8 one confirmed booking is not enough while another is pending (L4, CQ-05 as AC2 reads)
